#Study 2
```{r}
# Path to your data file (.csv or .xlsx), with one row per participant
data_file <- final

# Column names in YOUR data that correspond to each variable below
age_col    <- "age"
sex_col    <- "sex"
gender_col <- "gender"
race_col   <- "race_ethnicity"

#Need to check these

sex_levels <- c("Male", "Female", "Prefer not to answer", "No response")

gender_levels <- c("Man", "Woman", "Gender non-conforming", "Genderfluid",
                   "Other gender identity", "No response")

race_levels <- c("American Indian or Alaska Native", "Asian", "Black or African American",
                  "Hispanic or Latino", "Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander",
                  "White", "Two or more races", "Prefer not to answer", "No response")

output_file <- "demographic_table_study1.docx"

load_file <- function(path) {
  ext <- tolower(file_ext(path))
  if (ext == "csv") readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  else if (ext %in% c("xlsx", "xls")) readxl::read_excel(path)
  else stop("Unsupported file type: ", path)
}

# ---- Helper: build an "n (%)" block for one categorical variable ----
# `levels_order` fixes the row order and ensures every category appears,
# even if its count is 0.
categorical_block <- function(df, col, levels_order, header_label) {
  total_n <- sum(!is.na(df[[col]]))
  counts <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[col]])) %>%
    count(.data[[col]], name = "n") %>%
    rename(level = 1) %>%
    mutate(level = factor(level, levels = levels_order)) %>%
    complete(level, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    arrange(level) %>%
    mutate(pct = round(100 * n / total_n, 1),
           value = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct))

  bind_rows(
    tibble(Characteristic = header_label, value = ""),
    tibble(Characteristic = paste0("    ", counts$level), value = counts$value)
  )
}

# ---- Load data ----

for (col in c(age_col, sex_col, gender_col, race_col)) {
  if (!col %in% names(df)) {
    stop(sprintf("Column '%s' not found in %s. Available columns: %s",
                 col, data_file, paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")))
  }
}

# ---- Age block: Mean (SD) and Range ----
age_vals <- df[[age_col]][!is.na(df[[age_col]])]
age_block <- tibble(
  Characteristic = c("Age", "    Mean (SD)", "    Range"),
  value = c("",
            sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(age_vals), sd(age_vals)),
            sprintf("%.0f\u2013%.0f", min(age_vals), max(age_vals)))
)

# ---- Build each categorical block ----
sex_block    <- categorical_block(df, sex_col,    sex_levels,    "Sex")
gender_block <- categorical_block(df, gender_col, gender_levels, "Gender")
race_block   <- categorical_block(df, race_col,   race_levels,   "Race/Ethnicity")

table_data <- bind_rows(age_block, sex_block, gender_block, race_block) %>%
  rename(`n (%)` = value)

# ---- Build the APA-style flextable ----
n_total <- nrow(df)

ft <- flextable(table_data) %>%
  set_header_labels(Characteristic = "Characteristic", `n (%)` = "n (%) or M (SD)") %>%
  add_header_lines(values = sprintf("Table 1\nParticipant Demographics (N = %d)", n_total)) %>%
  align(j = 2, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 12, part = "all") %>%
  bold(i = 1, part = "header") %>%
  italic(i = 2, part = "header") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  hline_top(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
  hline(i = 1, part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "body", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
  autofit() %>%
  width(j = 1, width = 2.8) %>%
  width(j = 2, width = 2.0)

# Bold the section header rows (Age, Sex, Gender, Race/Ethnicity) within the body
section_rows <- which(table_data$`n (%)` == "")
ft <- bold(ft, i = section_rows, j = 1, part = "body")

# ---- Save to Word ----
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft)
print(doc, target = output_file)

cat(sprintf("Done. Table saved to %s\n", output_file))
cat(sprintf("N = %d participants\n", n_total))

```
